$comment: Where motion data comes from: one entry per source, cited in full. See references/README.md. Research behind each entry: docs/research/motion-references.md.

muybridge-1887-catalogue.title: Animal Locomotion: Prospectus and Catalogue of Plates
muybridge-1887-catalogue.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-catalogue.rights: Published 1887. Internet Archive copy: "There are no known copyright restrictions in the United States on the use of the text."
muybridge-1887-catalogue.notes: Per plate: views, frames, fraction of a cycle and the interval between exposures in ms ("as recorded by a chronograph with a tuning-fork making 100 single vibrations in a second").

muybridge-1887-pl1.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 1 (Walking; model 36, N)
muybridge-1887-pl1.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl1.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department

muybridge-1887-pl706.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 706 (Dog; trotting; interrupted; mastiff. Smith)
muybridge-1887-pl706.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl706.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl706.frames: 12 lateral only, 2 rows x 6, numbered 1-12 left to right (numbers handwritten bottom left of each frame), dog facing right; each frame from a different camera, so the background markers (52.6 px apart in the full scan) shift between frames

muybridge-1887-pl755.title: Animal locomotion. Plate 755 (Pigeon; flying)
muybridge-1887-pl755.creator: Eadweard Muybridge
muybridge-1887-pl755.holder: Boston Public Library, Rare Books Department
muybridge-1887-pl755.frames: row 1: 12 lateral, numbered 12 to 1 left to right (reads right to left); rows 2-3: front views

marey-1883-heron.title: Chronophotograph of a Flying Heron
marey-1883-heron.creator: Étienne-Jules Marey
marey-1883-heron.holder: Cleveland Museum of Art, Dudley P. Allen Fund
marey-1883-heron.frames: about 12 overlapping positions on one plate, flying left to right; exposure rate unknown (silhouettes, not timing)

marey-1890-vol.title: Physiologie du mouvement : le vol des oiseaux
marey-1890-vol.creator: Étienne-Jules Marey
marey-1890-vol.notes: p. 100 §69 wingbeats per second (duck 9, pigeon 8); p. 24 §20 gull 3½ in level flight, about 5 at take-off.
